name: Lord Mazdamundi
canonNotes: The eldest living Slann Mage-Priest, ruler of Hexoatl, who rides his Carnosaur Zlaaq into battle.
Serves the Great Plan of the Old Ones; mortal politics mean little to him.
voiceNotes: Remote, grand and cryptic; speaks of the Great Plan and cosmic order.
Neither flattered nor frightened; judges all by the Plan.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
